verdict.rationale: Asana has no documented changelog or release-notes feature. An engineer could assemble something similar from general building blocks: the status-update report tutorial and example app, MCP-based report and summary generation from Asana data, and syncing GitHub pull request status to tasks. This takes custom work or AI prompting rather than an out-of-the-box release changelog. Missing for 10: a native per-release changelog or release-notes generator, a concept of releases or versions to group shipped work, automatic triggering on release, and any hands-on evidence of changelog use.
